To find the point on the curve at \( t = 2 \), substitute \( t = 2 \) into the parametric equations:

\[
x = t^3 + 7 = 2^3 + 7 = 8 + 7 = 15
\]
\[
y = -3t^2 - 6t - 5 = -3(2^2) - 6(2) - 5 = -3(4) - 12 - 5 = -12 - 12 - 5 = -29
\]

The curve passes through \((15, -29)\) at \( t = 2 \).

Answer: (15, -29)
